rootCauses.explanation: dependencyConvergence: the fixed guice 7.0.0 dependency transitively pins guava 31.0.1-jre while the direct dependency now targets 33.4.8-jre; the enforcer refuses two different resolved versions for one artifact.
the lagging version arrives via the guice path (guice-parent 7.0.0 pins guava 31.0.1-jre, verified against the guice-parent pom); the direct bump alone cannot win resolution.

suggestedActions.detail: pin guava 33.4.8-jre in dependencyManagement so Maven resolves one version on every path
two steps: management-scope pin first, then the direct bump
